# `product_device`

Area: **inventory** ([all tables](README.md))

The devices a prepaid line has had, one row each: the IMEI the order gave and the network's compatibility answer at that time. The row without ended_at is the current device. Written only by orders (an add item or a device-change modify item); an incompatible device is refused and never stored.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` |  |
| `product_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `imei` | `text` | no |  | 15 digits, Luhn-checked before it is stored. |
| `compatibility` | `text` | no |  | The network's answer (BSS_NETWORK_ADAPTER check_device): compatible, or unknown (the network could not tell or did not answer: allowed with a warning). |
| `reasons` | `jsonb` | no | `'[]'::jsonb` | The network's reasons (bands, lock, VoLTE) as a JSON array of sentences; empty when compatible. |
| `checked_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | When the network was asked. |
| `started_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | When the order recorded this device (the order's clock time). |
| `ended_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | When a later device change closed this row; null while it is the current device. |
| `recorded_by_item_id` | `uuid` | no |  | The order item that recorded the device. |
| `ended_by_item_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | The order item whose device change closed the row. |

## Constraints

| Name | Kind | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| `product_device_check` | check | `CHECK (((ended_at IS NULL) = (ended_by_item_id IS NULL)))` |
| `product_device_check1` | check | `CHECK (((ended_at IS NULL) OR (ended_at >= started_at)))` |
| `product_device_compatibility_check` | check | `CHECK ((compatibility = ANY (ARRAY['compatible'::text, 'unknown'::text])))` |
| `product_device_imei_check` | check | `CHECK ((imei ~ '^[0-9]{15}$'::text))` |
| `product_device_reasons_check` | check | `CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(reasons) = 'array'::text))` |
| `product_device_pkey` | primary key | `PRIMARY KEY (id)` |
